note: Opus-confirmed (scans of n-1, n, n+1, blind to direction) pages whose English renders another leaf (next/prev) or two leaves (mixed), found by job wrong-leaf-find-5021 on 2026-11-03; NOT withheld (that job was read-only). For wrong-leaf-fix-5021.

pages.title: La Magie Naturelle (Secrets et Miracles de Nature)
pages.evidence: English 'restore a woman deflowered to her virginity, make pills' renders 'restablir vne femme defloree en sa virginité, faites luy des pillules' (p258); p257's own text (corne de cerf, Amiantus, noix de galle) is absent

pages.title: Bibliotheca, Acta et Scripta Magica, Vol. II
pages.evidence: 'submits to the calm inquiry of the learned, Felix Martinus Bræhm' = 'placidæ Eruditorum disquisitioni submittit, Felix Martinus Bræhm' (p829); 'a special Inquisition court against witches' = 'ein eigenes Inquisitions-Gerichte wider die Hexen' (p829). None of p828's 'Uberhaupt muß man sich... Regul halten' appears.

pages.title: Magie et Religion dans l'Afrique du Nord
pages.evidence: The body of the English renders page 150, not page 149: 'The theory of inoculation and that of propitiation are perhaps not contradictory' matches 'La théorie de l'inoculation et celle de la propitiation ne sont peut-être pas contradictoires' (p150), and 'these are the h'erz of the Arabs' matches 'ce sont les h'erz des arabes' (p150). Only the footnotes are page 149's own (Frazer, Crawley, Largeau).

pages.title: Li Ki: Mémoires sur les bienséances et les cérémonies
pages.evidence: Most of the English is the meat-dish list, which is printed on p659: 'beef broth, mutton broth... pheasants, hares, quails, and partridges' = 'le bouillon de bœuf... les faisans, les lièvres, les cailles, les perdrix' (p659). The grain list 'chòu glutinous millet, tsǐ... rice, large white millet' = '飯黍稷稻粱' / 'le chòu (millet glutineux), le tsǐ' and the 'ióu signifies' note = '猶若也' do come from p658. The English leaves out p658's main text about the cadet branches, the two victims and the sacrifice ('具二牲…宗子…私祭').

pages.title: Lotus Sutra (Miao fa lian hua jing) - Sixi Tripitaka Edition
pages.evidence: 'the World-Honored One said to the great assembly of bodhisattvas, "It is so, it is so"' = 爾時丗尊於菩薩大衆中而作是言如是如是 (p582). Page 581's four bodhisattvas (上行, 無邊行, 淨行, 安立行) are missing from the English.

pages.title: Corpus Hermeticum and Plotinus, Enneads
pages.evidence: 'Or is beauty one thing in a body, and another in something else?' renders 'ἢ ἄλλο μὲν ἐν σώματι τὸ κάλλος, ἄλλο δὲ ἐν ἄλλῳ' (p110). Page 109's own text (end of the treatise on happiness and the opening 'Τὸ καλόν, ἔστι μὲν ἐν ὄψει πλεῖστον') is not translated.

pages.title: 西洋新法曆書 (New Western Calendar Treatise)
pages.evidence: 'Shouxing Palace' and 'Celestial Gate', which the summary centres on, render 壽星辰宮 and 天門. Those labels are printed on p49, not p50, whose palace label is 大火卯宮. 'Battle Chariot' renders 陣車, which is printed on p50.

pages.title: Autolyci De Sphaera et De Ortibus (Hultsch 1885)
pages.evidence: English 'Philolaus says it is necessary that all things that are be either infinite, or limiting' renders 'Φιλόλαος δὲ ἀναγκαῖον τὰ ἐόντα πάντα εἶμεν ἤτοι ἄπειρα ἢ περαίνοντα' (p576). Page 575's own text (προμήκης vs ἑτερομήκης, 'ὁ ϛ ὑπὸ τοῦ δὶς γ') is not translated at all. The English also continues past p576 into the rows of squares and heteromecic numbers that come after it.

pages.title: Mercurii Trismegisti Pimander, Marsilio Ficino interprete
pages.evidence: 'Oblivion itself, however, is wickedness... The clothing of the mind is the soul' renders 'Obliuio autem ipsa improbitas e[st]... Indumentum mentis a[n]i[m]a' (p63), not p62's 'Tria igitur sunt hec, Deus pater bonum, & mundus, & homo'

pages.title: Platonis Opera Marsilio Ficino interprete
pages.evidence: English 'Could you cut vine branches with a sword and a chisel' matches 'Posses ne gladio et scalpello et multis alijs vitis palmites amputare' on p130; the English opens with 'they do not wish to harm one another', which is p130's first line 'se inuicem ledere nolint', and leaves out p129's own text ('Ciuitatem ne aliquam affirmares iniustam esse...')

pages.title: Synesius De somniis, Iamblichus, Proclus, Porphyrius, Ficino interprete
pages.evidence: English 'powers both dissolutive and again congregative' renders 'vires et dissolutiuę et rursus congregatiuę' (p145); nothing from p144 (e.g. 'mundus est unum animal') appears

pages.title: Erster [- zehender] Theil der Bücher und Schrifften des edlen, hochgelehrten und bewehrten
pages.evidence: The English covers only the last paragraph of 1277 ('How gladly you say...' = 'Wie gern sprechen jhr...'). Everything after that renders p1278: 'Who can bring out as much mercury as you smear and smoke inside?' = 'Wer kan so viel Quecksilber herauß bringen / als jhr hinein schmirben / vñ reuchen?' (p1278), running through to 'Searching for spiderwebs' = 'suchest Spinnenwep' (p1278). None of 1277's main text (Cacophrastus, Galenus, Pilatus Meer) appears.

pages.title: Monas hieroglyphica
pages.evidence: 'With these few things, I know that I give not only such starting points' renders 'His paucis, tales me scio non ἀφορμὰς, solum' (p93). Page 92 itself has only 'dium ferentes. Ipsa enim quæ in Alpha...' and the Alpha/Cross/Omega table, which this English does not translate.

pages.title: Yuelü Quanshu (樂律全書) Vols. 4-5
pages.evidence: 'Years have times of famine and abundance, lands have varying fertility' = 年有凶豐地有肥瘠 (p117); 'Huangzhong symbolizes yang... until reaching Wuyi' = 黃鍾象陽以次而短至無射而極 (p117). Page 116's own text (可見矣獨所謂律和聲者…仰觀俯察於秬黍) is not rendered.

pages.title: Opera didactica omnia
pages.evidence: 'A sober man... does all things soberly; you therefore strive for sobriety' renders 'tas vitium. SOBRI-us ... agit omnia -è: tu ergò stude -etati' at the top of the right column of p659 (the English then runs through Ego, Ehem, Eleemosyna, also p659), whereas p660 opens '-econde) victualia' and covers Emere through Exemplum

pages.title: The kabbala: or, the true science of light. An introduction to the philosophy and theosoph
pages.evidence: English 'the famous Ionian philosopher, Anaximander' matches 'the famous Ionian Philosopher, Anaximander' on page -9 (pp. 10–11), not page -10's text about the Kabbala and Infidelity

pages.title: De proprietatibus rerum
pages.evidence: The English 'Of the platanus, Chapter CXIX... As a plane tree I was exalted' renders 'De platano Ca. CXIX ... quasi platanus exaltata sum', which is printed on p432. Page 433 itself begins 'et odoriferum facit fumum' (pine) and continues with 'De pinea Ca. CXXII'.

pages.title: 韓非子 (Han Feizi)
pages.evidence: English 'Laws alone cannot carry themselves into practice' and 'The political theory of the Confucians is one of rule by virtue' render 徒法不レ能二以自行一 and 儒家の政治説は、徳治主義で on page 34. Page 35 itself is about 墨翟, 老荘 and 韓子 (此の世を周の黄金時代…).

pages.title: 聊齋志異 (Liaozhai Zhiyi / Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio), Vol. 1
pages.evidence: English 'eyes like lightning, and understanding that penetrates walls... the Six Classics' = 眼光如電牆壁皆通…則六經之義 (p16); 'Written by Gao Heng, the Daoist of Purple Clouds' = 紫霞道人高珩題 (p16). The text printed on p15 (止生花且同煉石…萍實商羊) does not appear in the English.

pages.title: 本草綱目 (Běncǎo Gāngmù), Vol. 15
pages.evidence: The English has two parts. The first renders the start of the centipede entry from page 10: 'Huainanzi says "The soaring snake wanders in fog but is endangered by the Chuju"' matches 淮南子云騰蛇遊霧而殆於蝍蛆 (p10). The second renders page 11's own text: 'The Youyang Zazu says... can use their qi to suck in a lizard' matches 酉陽雜俎云…能以氣吸蜴蜥 (p11). Each part is a substantial share of the English.

pages.title: Thadrak Kanjur rGyud 'bum Nga
pages.evidence: The first half of the English renders the lower leaf of p93: 'by stretching the left leg, one presses down the body of Yamantaka' = རྐང་པ་གཡོན་ཉིད་བརྐྱང་བ་ཡིས། །འཇིགས་བྱེད་མནན་པ་ཡི་ནི་ལུས (p93). The second half renders the upper leaf of p94: 'with six arms and black in color, in union with the Iron-Chain Lady' = དྲུག་པ་ལ་ཁ་དོག་གནག །ལྕགས་སྒྲོག་མ་དང་ལྷན་ཅིག་སྦྱོར (p94). The upper leaf of p93 (flower offering verses མེ་ཏོག་འདི་རྣམས་བཟང་ཞིང་དགེ, end of chapter 14) is not translated.

pages.title: Thadrak Kanjur mDo sde Sha
pages.evidence: The first half renders p103's own first leaf: 'liberated from fear and old age' = p103 'འཇིགས་དང་རྒ་བ་ལས་རྣམ་གྲོལ'. After the leaf break, the English renders p104's first leaf instead of p103's second leaf (which is about sounds): 'The Dharma called "contentment" is something to be supremely cherished' = p104 'ཆོག་ཤེས་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་ཆོས་ནི་མཆོག་ཏུ་གཅེས་པར་བྱ་བ་ཡིན'.

pages.title: Thadrak Kanjur dKon brtsegs Nga
pages.evidence: The first half renders p269's own lower leaf: 'the cessation of suffering is called non-arising… two truths: the conventional truth and the ultimate truth' = སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཟད་པ་གང་ཡིན་པ་དེ་ནི་མི་སྐྱེ་བ་ཞེས་བྱའོ… ཀུན་རྫོབ་ཀྱི་བདེན་པ་དང་། དོན་དམ་པའི་བདེན་པ (p269), ending 'whatever is accompanied by formation has destruction' = གང་མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱེད་པ་དང་བཅས་པ་དེ་ལ་ནི་འཇིག་པ་ཡོད་ཀྱི (p269). The second half ('it is merely expressed as a conventional designation… difficult for the lazy to realize') is not on p269. It seems to continue after p270's last words, ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད་ནི་སངས་རྒྱས་རྣམས་ཀྱི་བྱང་ཅུབ་ཡིན་ནོ། །ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཡང་ (p270), so it is probably from p271. None of p269's upper leaf (མིག་དང་བྲལ་བ་ལ་ཡང་ཕྱོགས་པར་མི་མཛད) is translated.

pages.title: Kanjur 'Dul ba Nga
pages.evidence: English 'Purna was fierce, harsh, and reckless' matches the Tibetan 'གང་བ་ནི་གཏུམ་པ ། བརླང་བ ། གཟུ་ལུམས་ཅན' on page 372, and 'he graces the Brahmadatta pond' matches 'ཚངས་ལྡན་གྱི་རྫིང་གི་རྒྱན་བྱེད' on page 372. Page 371's own text, the swans' leader named Yul 'khor skyong and the lake Ma dros pa, is not translated.

pages.title: चरकसंहिता (Caraka Saṃhitā)
pages.evidence: 'Agnivesha then asked: O venerable one, what is the root of engagement and disengagement' = 'अथाग्निवेश उवाच । किंमूला भगवन् प्रवृत्तिनिवृत्तौ' (p478, §7); 'I am endowed with such birth, form, wealth' = 'जातिरूपवित्तबुद्धिशील…सम्पन्नोऽहमित्यहङ्कारः' (p478). Page 477 itself has §§4–5 (loka–purusha correspondences, Indra = ahankara, kṛtayuga = childhood), none of which appear in the English; the later part of the English runs past p478 into the following text.

pages.title: 墨子 (Mòzǐ)
pages.evidence: The English "Mozi in Fifteen Volumes… Record of Classics in the History of Tang… Regarding the Records of the Grand Historian" renders 墨子十五卷 / 唐書經籍志 / 案史記墨翟或曰竝孔子時, which is printed in image p21.jpg (page 21). The page 20 scan (p20.jpg) actually shows 子故勸子也遂不復求仕…甘瓜苦蒂…君子服美則益敬. Note: each image shows the text that the transcription gives for the page before it. The p19.jpg scan shows 斷指以存脛…墨子勸弟子學.

pages.title: رحلة ابن بطوطة (Riḥlat Ibn Baṭṭūṭa)
pages.evidence: The English 'the armies became intermingled and the dust rose... I stuck to the Khatun's baggage' renders 'اختلطت العساكر وكثر العجاج ... فلزمت أثقال الخاتون' (p270). The English also includes 'Account of the Sultan of Constantinople... Takfur' = 'ذكر سلطان القسطنطينية واسمه تكفور' (p270). Page 269's own text, about the procession with the Khatun's brothers and the Sultan coming out ('وخرج السلطان وزوجته أم هذه الخاتون'), is missing from the English.

pages.title: Liu yi liu bie, 20 juan
pages.evidence: 'The Han dynasty inherited the destiny of Yao to establish its imperial legacy' = 漢紹堯運以建帝業 (p886); 'Record of Searching the Mountains' = 尋山志 (p886). Page 885's own text (孟子題辭 continuation, 楊朱墨翟, 公孫丑萬章) is not rendered.

pages.title: Liu yi liu bie, 20 juan
pages.evidence: 'Record of the Yigu Valley of Mount Zhongnan … by Yu Xin of the Later Zhou' and 'I ask the fisherman for the way ahead, and he points me toward Penglai' = 終南山義谷志 後周庾信 and 問漁人以前路指示予以蓬萊 (p887); none of p886's text (漢書 postface, 倦世情之易繞) is rendered

pages.title: Beati Raymundi Lulli Doctoris Illuminati et Martyris Opera, Tomus I (Salzinger ed., Mainz)
pages.evidence: 'who deem this farrago of Books useless and superfluous' = 'qui inutilem censeant & superfluam (ne dicam) noxiam hanc Librorum farraginem' (p21). Page 20's own text ('Privilegium Cæsareum', 'Heidelbergæ') is not rendered.
